raw_tokens.value: Oadiran Horselord ~ Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A Qadiran horselord is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with light and medium armor, and with shields (except tower shields). This replaces the cavalier's normal weapon and armor proficiencies.
